notes.title: Me and Yoda (Mega Man X DiVE)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33598529/3a10cd665bc40f59bd4447b04225b0ae3462794a.jpg[/img]

Today CAPCOM officially announced that Mega Man X DiVE is about to end its operations. After I finished TAYAL 4 years ago, I joined CAPCOM's Mega Man x DiVE development team.

I still remember the first touch. When I tried my best to complete the debut animation of the Ultimate Armor X of Mega Man X4. The emotion brought about by seeing the enthusiastic reaction in the community is still fresh in my memory. 

Finally, I would like to thank you guys for your support of DiVE over the past 4 years.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & improvements (v 1.1.1)
notes.notes:
[h1]💬MESSAGE[/h1]
Hi guys, sorry about I late to update the new announcement. I still busy on Mega Man X DiVE recently. But at the same time, I also have received some feedback from TAYAL and also have founded some bug issues. so except fixed these and I had to change some things with the game. Simply say it that is a friendly update this time.

Also here, I have to say an apology for the players who like the hardest level design of the previous version. After consideration, I do decide to reduce the difficulty of mainline level design for the most light-users. But I promise here, I'll add a new additional "Challenge Mode", one long stage with hell difficult. I wanna challenge you guys with this new level. (Don't blame me...

And...after 2 years, thank you guys a lot for TAYAL has sold out 600 copies.


[h1]🔨FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed black screen with the first boot-up of the game.
[/list]


[h1]🎮IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] some level design, enemies & bosses behavior adjustment
[*] some enemies balance
[*] add an operation that switches stream force with press button L & R at the same time.
[*] add all checkpoints to 4
[/list]

Hello, I'm Ewing. After 4 years of development.

I know there are still many imperfections.
As a big fan of MEGA, I do everything in my power to make it better.
Hope you like this little fan game.
